classification: historical external forestry-communications company founded by Ellis (Eli) Hoberg before Sable Harbor
approval_basis: Owner supplied a Quality Forest Management visual reference, requested Quality Forest Communications with an AN/PRC-117G and tree antenna, restored the yellow Q, then specified a smaller radio inside the Q and the classic 2055 SATCOM antenna. After viewing the final revision, the owner instructed: Nice. Lock it for QFC.

assets.source: Exact owner-selected final imagegen output, copied byte-for-byte without edits

reproduction_rule: The full horizontal PNG is the sole approved form. Preserve source pixels and white background; no separate tree/Q mark, vector, monochrome, reverse or transparent derivative is approved.
relationship_rule: QFC is Hoberg's pre-Sable Harbor company. The logo does not establish a Sable Harbor subsidiary, current business line, acquisition or new legal or military relationship.
